question: Does URL-filtered BrowserContext.cookies(scopeURL) preserve a cookie that applies only to another origin while still selecting a parent-domain cookie that genuinely applies to the controlled URL?
interpretation: Playwright URL filtering follows cookie applicability rather than exact hostname equality. The candidate therefore excludes state that does not apply to app A while retaining parent-domain entries that do apply to app A.
limit: This executes Playwright/Chromium cookie semantics, not the full Next.js e2e harness.
